chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from a number of our companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Water is not to be heated for the deceased, fire is not to be hastened for him, and he is not to be embalmed with musk.

key_terms.يُحَنَّطُ: to be embalmed or have hanut applied
key_terms.ٱلنَّارُ: fire, here meaning bringing or hastening fire for the deceased
key_terms.ٱلْمَاءُ: the water used in relation to preparing the deceased

ai.seo_question: What are the rulings on heating water, using fire, and applying musk for the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives funeral-related rulings concerning the treatment of the deceased before burial. It prohibits heating water for the deceased, bringing fire near him, and using musk in his hanut, indicating specific legal etiquette in preparing the dead.
